I took all the adderall at about 9 am. Stayed up all day and night.
At about 4 am I took a nuvigil. I was coming down off of the adderall and decided to try to stay up since I couldnt sleep. At 7:15 am. I am feeling great. Completely killed the crash and lifted me back up.
